decision: Do not suppress either basis because the pump or M2 is shared. May group editorially only if both cross-document identity conflict and same-drawing duplicate position remain explicit with their own evidence. Preserve other F003 systems and literal МЗ.

scope: Coordinator comparison of exact preserved statements and previously reviewed primary sources, not engineer acceptance or a model deduplication result.
